calls.statement:
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=131 AND f.product_key IN (SELECT product_key FROM dim_product WHERE sku=101624)
AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-26' AND DATE '2026-10-06'
ORDER BY f.sale_date, f.receipt_id, f.line_no

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dist_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_ids, max(f.etl_loaded_at) mx, min(f.etl_loaded_at) mn
FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date d, sum(f.quantity) units, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(*) n
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT r.business_date, r.units_sold, r.net_sales_before_returns, l.units, l.net, l.n
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r LEFT JOIN l ON l.d=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=131 AND r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) n, sum(quantity) q FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=131 AND f.product_key=1702 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'sold' k, s.store_id, p.sku, p.product_name, sum(f.quantity) units
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.sku=101624 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returned_in_week', s.store_id, p.sku, p.product_name, sum(r.quantity_returned)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.sku=101624 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY ALL
